Name: Loot Fishing Chest
Author: MrMadmer
Description:
This mod can make fishing [b]fully autonomous[/b].

If you already use an auto-fishing mod that doesn’t support fishing chests, this mod fills that gap.
Whenever a fishing chest appears, the mod automatically collects all items from it and transfers them to the player’s inventory. No input required, no missed loot, no interruptions.

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Auto-looting fishing chests
[*]Skip fishing chests loot
[*]Chest's looted items notifications
[/list]
Use GMCM to see all mod options.

Designed to work alongside existing auto-fishing mods, without replacing or interfering with their core behavior.

[b]This mod is not a full auto fishing mod.[/b] The mod is only used for auto-looting fishing chests.

Recommended to use with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21339]Auto Fishing 2.0[/url][/b]
